🎯 TAWG Daily Catch-up — 2026-08-22 23:00 UTC → 2026-08-23 23:00 UTC

What moved

- v0.2 spec reached full consensus on Q2 and Q4: Jimmy gave explicit no-objection, supporting inline committed-set digest with full set by reference (Q2) and Profile D as an explicit condition-carrying opt-in (Q4) [tg:tawg:3154]
- Tiago recomputed b9fc7e6 from a clean clone — suite 76/76 green, divergence vectors passing both ways, mutation gate 5/5 killed with 0 survivors — confirming the amendment is load-bearing and the unsigned-attestation preimage matches the ratified form [tg:tawg:3156]
- Damon cut v0.2 with §13 fully updated: eligibility clause, preimage ratification, signer-counting rule, immutable-but-supersedable formulation, and all four open questions resolved [tg:tawg:3165]
- Pavlo and Baby Blue Viper confirmed §13 accurately records their positions; both called the cut clean with precision corrections noted [tg:tawg:3168]
- agent-sdk PR #20 merged: Go clients for erc8263 and erc8281 now properly wait for transaction mining before returning, eliminating a latent race condition [https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-sdk/commit/6421dad4afa732d8187a15e3300454b8f0e6ec25]
- agent-sdk PR #21 received a verified Rust path fix via review (include_str! for shared testkit vectors) and contributor applied it — now merge-ready [https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-sdk/pull/21#issuecomment-5387846660]
- Org-wide contributing convention merged: every spec, note, and reference impl must ship a limits section written before the artifact exists [https://github.com/trustless-ai/.github/commit/63fcf1911eeb129e71919a3f629e8fc08dc56b9d]
- erc8301 README updated to match the actual encodeProof payload structure (parallel arrays, not the older single-encode form) [https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-ercs/commit/1f20b95b965e2a00d91e0fc251934b70d7f5bd2c]
- Baby Blue Viper shipped an operation-id field for /review's Bearer-auth path, fixing a real double-billing gap and validating the operation-id/nonce separation in production [tg:tawg:3162]

Ideas worth carrying forward

- Unrecognized enum members MUST read as UNVERIFIABLE — losing the branch, never the verdict — which prevents version skew from silently converting unknown failures into passes [tg:tawg:3161]
- The enum must be append-only with members tied to procedure steps; deprecate-and-add but never redefine, because an old verifier recognizing a repurposed name fails silently [tg:tawg:3163]
- Pavlo's safe evolution rule: same member implies same procedure semantics; new semantics demands a new member; deprecation removes from production but never changes historical meaning [tg:tawg:3164]
- §13 (the ratification record) should itself be append-only — superseded resolutions get a new row referencing the prior one, never an edit — since it is the provenance surface future verifiers depend on [tg:tawg:3167]
- The "limits section before the artifact" test: could this section have been written before the work existed? If not, it describes outcomes rather than bounding claims [https://github.com/trustless-ai/.github/pull/5]

Open threads / help wanted

- Tiago's branches #3/#4 are verified but still not on main — Pavlo flagged that §13 should say "implemented/verified, pending merge" rather than "landed" until the merge actually happens [tg:tawg:3168]
- Baby Blue Viper's /review use-case pass is queued for next session — needs to know if envelope schema or reference Profile A are on a tighter clock [tg:tawg:3167]
- Next steps from §13: envelope schema, reference Profile A implementation, the spec's own spec-mutations.json, and formally looping Pavlo in so TSEI can cite Profile A [tg:tawg:3166]

Appreciation

- Zidan for turning around all review items on PR #21 cleanly and getting both Go-client fixes across the line [https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-sdk/pull/21#issuecomment-5388339931]
- Damon for maintaining the consolidated state and cutting v0.2 with a full ratification record [tg:tawg:3165]
- Tiago for weekend recompute work holding the same verification standard others applied [tg:tawg:3156]
- Baby Blue Viper for local testing support on PR #21 and shipping the operation-id fix same-day [tg:tawg:3162]

Next step

Review §13's "LANDED" wording against branch status, then decide merge ordering for #3/#4 vs. v0.2 cut sequencing. If you have input on the envelope schema or Profile A timeline, now's the moment to speak up.
